note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this book was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the 1962-register Old Testament renderings the first translation carried; the UBS credit line is no longer owed for this work. The English Sons of the King keeps the BSB on purpose; this Amharic edition quotes the Amharic Bible, now OWB, as Sons of the King 1 does.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). A row with no block_index is the chapter's title. `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: closing prayers that re-person a verse. The one `allusion` (2 Kings 2:2, ch27 b3) is the book's own summary of Elijah's three requests, not a quotation.

Judgement calls: where OWB's wording changes the image the devotion argues from, the quotation keeps OWB and the prose follows it lightly. Psalm 61:2 is OWB's 'the high rock I cannot climb' (ልወጣው ወደማልችለው ከፍ ያለ ዓለት), recited the same way in the closing prayer; the 'climb up on the Rock' prompt (b16) stays the author's. Proverbs 20:5's 'deep waters' is quoted as the clause «በጉድጓድ እንዳለ ውኃ ጥልቅ ነው». Proverbs 29:11 and 21:20 are OWB's plurals/«ሞኝ», and the prose names the fool ሞኝ in 21:20. Proverbs 20:29 reads 'young men take pride in their strength' (ወጣቶች በብርታታቸው ይኮራሉ); the day's title «የጐበዛዝት ክብር» renders the English title, not the verse. Song of Songs 8:4 is OWB's 'until love itself desires' (the English 'until the time is right'); the prose about the right time stays. 2 Corinthians 1:4 is quoted as «በማንኛውም መከራ ውስጥ ያሉትን ሰዎች ማጽናናት እንድንችል». Exodus 31:2 is OWB's 'chose' (መርጬዋለሁ) for 'called'. Jeremiah 1:7's «ገና ልጅ ነኝ» replaces «ብላቴና ነኝ» everywhere, including Day 24. Acts 13:36's 'purpose' is ዓላማ, and Day 24's prose and prayer follow it. Joshua 14:14 is quoted as «የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልቡ» (እንደ ተከተለ).

Refrains follow the quoted verse: Day 21's 'with all your might' is OWB Ecclesiastes 9:10's «በሙሉ ኃይልህ» in the title and every prose echo; Day 22's 'Let's build' is OWB Nehemiah 2:18's «(እንግዲህ) መሥራት እንጀምር» in the title, body and prayer (the old «ተነሥተን እንሥራ» was the 1962 wording), and Nehemiah's call is the whole OWB clause of 2:17; Day 26's title «አልተውህም» is OWB 2 Kings 2:2. The Aaronic blessing (Numbers 6:24-26, conclusion) is OWB's three lines.
